name: Kubernetes
description: Cluster, node and job dashboards with pod, workload and node alerts, from the Datadog agent.
details:
## Setup

Collected by the Datadog agent. See [Kubernetes with the Datadog Agent](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/integration/dd-agent/kubernetes/).

Node and workload metrics come from the agent's built-in Kubernetes checks once it runs as a DaemonSet with the Cluster Agent; no annotations are needed.

targets.expr:
sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_daemon_set)(kubernetes_state_daemonset_ready{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) /
sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_daemon_set)(kubernetes_state_daemonset_desired{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"})

sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_stateful_set)(kubernetes_state_statefulset_replicas_ready{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) /
sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_stateful_set)(kubernetes_state_statefulset_replicas_desired{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) > 0

sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_replica_set)(kubernetes_state_replicaset_replicas_ready{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) /
sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_replica_set)(kubernetes_state_replicaset_replicas_desired{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) > 0

rules.title: Some K8S deployment(s) have lesser replicas available than desired for last 15 minutes

annotations.summary: Some K8S pods are restarting for last 5 minutes

rules.title: Some K8S pods are using more CPU in the last 5 minutes

model.expr: (avg by (kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, pod_name)(kubernetes_cpu_usage_total{pod_name=~".+"} offset 5m) - avg by (kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, pod_name)(kubernetes_cpu_usage_total{pod_name=~".+"})) / avg by (kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, pod_name)(kubernetes_cpu_usage_total{pod_name=~".+"} offset 5m)
